text: Fresh full one-file33-line CI configuration patch read. It registers a test-manifest source-test job running commlint -v -l test-manifest-toml with Treeherder and JSON output for comm and a skip-unless-mozlint reference to the TOML linter configuration. This invokes a configured linter; it does not define all TOML rules or itself demonstrate that any manifest passes. The related118-file preparation landing is a separate source audit. Fixed source retains the named task. The source-test kind loads mozlint.yml and defaults code-review true; a separate current comm transform removes optimizations for such jobs on comm-central hg-push unless always is set. Therefore the literal skip-unless field alone is not a complete scheduling contract. The linter wrapper/config excludes Cargo and other non-test TOML families and Marionette manifests. No taskgraph, linter, manifest parse or CI execution ran.
title: A TOML linter job depends on its wrapper and task-selection transforms
